entities.name: Query 231 aa Ham1p-like protein
observations: The query sequence is 231 amino acids long with estimated molecular weight 25.73 kDa, theoretical pI 6.71, and near-neutral calculated charge at pH 7.
The sequence contains a Ham1p_like Pfam domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 12–221 with i-Evalue 1.8e-53.
The sequence has 47.8% identity over 90.5% query coverage to reviewed UniProt protein Q8KFJ6, a dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase.
The sequence has 42.3% identity over 89.2% query coverage to reviewed Thermoanaerobacter dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homologs B0K3T5 and B0KBM4.
Homology supports assignment as a noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphatase, but exact substrate preference is inferred rather than experimentally established for the query.

entities.name: Q8KFJ6
observations: Reviewed Chlorobaculum tepidum dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homolog; 47.8% identity and 90.5% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated as EC 3.6.1.66 and reported to hydrolyze XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphates and diphosphate.
Annotated Mg2+ dependence, one Mg2+ ion per subunit, homodimeric state, and cytosolic localization.

entities.name: B0K3T5
observations: Reviewed Thermoanaerobacter dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homolog with 42.3% identity and 89.2% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated with EC 3.6.1.66, Mg2+ dependence, homodimeric state, and activity toward XTP, dITP, and ITP.

entities.name: B0KBM4
observations: Reviewed Thermoanaerobacter pseudethanolicus dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homolog with 42.3% identity and 89.2% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated with EC 3.6.1.66, Mg2+ dependence, homodimeric state, and activity toward XTP, dITP, and ITP.
